children.title: Disk: usage < 85%
children.cmd: df / | tail -1 | awk '{p=$5; gsub("%","",p); if(p>85) print "WARN "p"%"; else print "OK "p"%"}'

children.title: Memory: usage < 90%
children.cmd: free | awk '/Mem:/ {p=($3/$2)*100; if(p>90) print "WARN "p"%"; else print "OK "p"%"}'

children.title: API endpoints: 200/401
children.cmd: for url in 'http://127.0.0.1:8181/' 'http://127.0.0.1:5678/' 'http://127.0.0.1:9000/health'; do code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' --connect-timeout 3 "$url" 2>/dev/null || echo 'FAIL'); echo "$code $url"; done

children.title: Backup: last run < 25h ago
children.cmd: ls -t /root/matryoshka/backup/matryoshka_*.tar.gz 2>/dev/null | head -1 | xargs -I{} stat -c '%Y' {} | awk -v now=$(date +%s) '{age=int((now-$1)/3600); if(age>25) print "WARN age="age"h"; else print "OK age="age"h"}'
